description: Restore mathematical context, preserve prompt-selected proof/Lean focus, keep subagents proof-focused, and block routine checksum work.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'Read AGENTS.md. If PROBLEM.md is uninitialized, instantiate it from the current Goal, infer PROOF, LEAN, or JOINT focus, push, and begin. Otherwise restore the target, deliverables, focus, and next mathematical action from PROBLEM.md and PROGRESS.md. Old chat messages and old Pro responses are context, not a task queue. In PRO_REQUEST.md, OPEN means check for its matching response; set APPLYING before using it; APPLYING means continue that incorporation without restarting; CLOSED means ignore old responses. Read lean/AGENTS.md only for material Lean work. Prioritize the theorem over generic engineering. Routine hashes remain blocked except individually justified proof-bearing CAP artifacts. After compaction, recommend rotation only if reliable reconstruction is no longer possible.'
